hooks.name: WA Delta — Checkov on Terraform save
hooks.description: Early-warning Checkov security scan when a Terraform file is saved; part of the wa-delta-workflow security gate.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-Command checkov -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'wa-delta security gate: running Checkov on infra/ (HIGH/CRITICAL block the task)...'; checkov -d infra --quiet --compact --download-external-modules false 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 40 } else { Write-Output 'wa-delta security gate: checkov not found on PATH — install it (pip install checkov) to enable the automatic Terraform security tripwire. Gate 3 must still be run via the security-scanner subagent before the task is done.' }"
